title: MLP Expansion Reduction (4x → 3x)
description: Reduce per-step FLOPs to fit more steps in 5-minute budget
reflection: Abandoned because a0 independently proposed the identical change (#35). Running duplicate experiments wastes the group's limited budget (26 runs remaining). Let a0 run MLP once; if it succeeds, we have the result; if it crashes, they retry within their attempt budget. This preserves compute for exploring orthogonal ideas like a1's Muon LR increase.
